Maria (ML): quick heads-up — the q4/int4 bring-up we ran on promptset_v7 is showing a QoL regression on a small but important slice (code completion & instruction summarization). ~8% drop vs float32 on our golden eval. can we triage?
Ajay (Infra): ugh. which configs did you test?
Maria (ML): test matrix: q4_int4_kv-prefetch, q4_int4_no-kvcache, q8b_int3 baseline float32. issue spikes on long-prefix code prompts. i suspect kv cache handling + quant kernel mismatch.
Zhen: can you paste the eval command? I'll try to repro locally.
Maria (ML): sure — ran:
```
run_eval --model redwood-q4b-int4 --prompts=promptset_v7_longprefix.json --gold=gold_v3.json --metrics=exact_match,rouge,f1 --batch-size=8
```
Maria (ML): attached a small CSV of failure ids: failure_ids.csv (28 rows) — many are near-duplicate paraphrases, some deid tokens changed. might be a sampling/de-dup artifact too.
Lia: i'll pick this up for labeling triage. Lia: plan: repro small smoke with/without kvcache, then send 50 examples to labelers for pairwise compare (gold vs q4). anyone object? :+1:
Ajay (Infra): no objections. i'll spin a single p4d for a quick smoke tomorrow morning and reserve /gpu/stack/ephemeral-12. link: https://infra/redwood/runs/ephemeral-12
LabelerBot: Assigned 50 examples (batch 2026-03-24-01) -> Lia, estimated completion 8h.
Zhen: when you repro, add this env var to force kernel fallback: `export REDWOOD_KERNEL_MODE=compat`. if regression disappears that's a kernel selection bug.
Maria (ML): good call. also try `--kv-cache=off` flag to isolate kv behavior.
Lia: quick checklist for labels: 1) is output correct for intent? 2) does it omit required steps? 3) hallucination markers? 4) alignment to gold? keep labels terse (ok/partial/bad) and a 1-sentence note for partials.
Lia: i'll kick off dedupe pass before labeling with `fuzzy_hash=0.85` and sample stratified by prompt_length and model_token_count.
Zhen: for de-dup script use: `python dedupe.py --threshold 0.85 --keep=longer`. I noticed microparaphrases causing longprefix mismatch in earlier runs.
Maria (ML): if labelers mark >15% partial/bad, we escalate to model team and pause rollout. current baseline float32 golden had 3.2% partial/bad so 15% is high-sensitivity threshold.
Ajay (Infra): ETA on smoke run? Lia: when you want the GPU?
Lia: prefer tomorrow 08:00 PST for infra slot, will run both `q4_int4_kv` and `q4_int4_no-kv` and one `q8_int3` control. should be ~90s per model for the 50-sample set.
LabelerBot: Lia marked batch 2026-03-24-01 as in_progress.
Zhen: i'll also push a small rerun that logs KV cache hits per token with `--trace-kv` so we can correlate mispredictions with cache misses.
Maria (ML): great. once labels are back Lia, please update golden set if failures are confirmed as real regressions (i.e., label=bad or partial with critical missing steps). add short note to golden changelog: "q4-int4-repro-2026-03-24"
Lia: noted. i'll also run a quick quant-smoke using `--quant-mode=int4-highbias` to see sensitivity to quant hyperparams.
Ajay (Infra): i'll leave the GPU reserved for a 4h window; ping me when done and i'll tear down. also opened infra ticket: INF-2026-341 to track this smoke and resource usage.
Maria (ML): thanks team. good followups: 1) Lia run + labels, 2) Zhen KV trace + kernel-mode toggle, 3) Ajay infra slot + run link, 4) Maria will assemble regression triage doc and ping product if we need to freeze rollout. will reconvene here after label pass. :mag:
Lia: starting dedupe now, will post sample IDs and the small label form link in this thread when ready.
LabelerBot: Completed assignment 2026-03-24-01 -> 12/50 labeled, 38 pending. Lia: reminder ping.
Zhen: repro done locally with `REDWOOD_KERNEL_MODE=compat` — regression drops to ~1.1%. looks like kernel selection is the culprit for longprefix samples. pushing patch to try kernel pin for q4.
Maria (ML): excellent. Lia: hold labeling for any examples where Zhen's kernel fix resolves — we can avoid wasted labels. Lia: please wait 30m before continuing.
Lia: paused. posting updated sample list in 30m.
LabelerBot: assignment 2026-03-24-01 status -> paused by Lia.
